question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin now, or wait for the richer Gateway activity contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The issue asks for new dashboard product surface and the linked PR makes a design choice about using coarse session rows for activity/progress, so automation should not resolve the direction by opening a new fix PR.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the open ops-widget PR as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader per-session activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let the modular dashboard tracker own sequencing only after this issue's unique status-widget requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the open ops-widget PR as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.
